data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of Ironman Marbella 2039 is a monumental achievement. After months of training and a gruelling 3.8 km swim, 180 km bike, and 42.2 km run, your body deserves more than a protein shake. A post-race recovery yacht charter in Puerto Banús offers the ultimate reset: cold-water plunges in the Mediterranean, gentle sea breezes, and gourmet snacks while your muscles repair. With boats departing from the heart of Marbella's luxury marina, you can turn race day into a celebration of endurance.

Why a Yacht Charter is Perfect for Ironman Recovery

Recovery after an Ironman isn't just about rest — it's about active recovery. Gentle swimming in calm, cool waters reduces muscle soreness and inflammation. The Costa del Sol's average October sea temperature of 20–22 °C provides the ideal contrast therapy. Onboard, you can stretch, hydrate, and refuel with the included drinks and snacks while watching the sunset over La Concha mountain. No gym, no ice baths — just the open sea.

Our Recovery-Ready Fleet in Puerto Banús

We offer a range of yachts tailored to post-race groups. For 2–5 people, the Dubhe (8 m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4 m, 5 pax) are compact and intimate. For groups of 6–11, the Astondoa 40 (12.5 m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5 m, 11 pax) provide ample deck space and shaded seating. Larger parties of up to 12 can book the Mangusta 80 (24 m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6 m). All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and VAT.

Pricing for Post-Race Charters

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and snacks. For a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (Tier B) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours, with a free jet ski included. Other boats are priced on request — simply contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

Best Itineraries for Recovery

We recommend a gentle cruise from Puerto Banús towards Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where calm waters allow for easy swimming and floating. Alternatively, head east to Marbella Marina for a scenic view of the Golden Mile. A 3–4 hour charter is ideal: enough time to swim, sunbathe, and enjoy the included cava without overexertion. For longer recovery sessions, our 8-hour charters include stops for a light lunch.

What's Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed, English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) included in the price

How to Book Your Recovery Day

Booking is simple. Choose your boat from our full fleet, then message us on WhatsApp with your preferred date and duration. We recommend booking at least one week in advance, especially during the Ironman weekend. Payment is secure, and we'll confirm your departure time from Puerto Banús. After the race, just show up with your swimsuit and towel — we take care of the rest.
